standard_prerequisites.name: The presentation of a quasi-DM algebraic stack by a flat, locally finitely presented and locally quasi-finite groupoid in algebraic spaces

standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the groupoid from which the residual gerbe is built.

standard_prerequisites.name: The quotient stack of a flat groupoid, the behaviour of that quotient under restricting the groupoid along a monomorphism, and the injectivity of the induced map on points for a monomorphism of stacks
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 7101-7105, 7132-7144) as cross-chapter pointers
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the stack constructed in the proof with the original one and shows that its map to the stack is injective on points.

standard_prerequisites.name: The uniqueness of the residual gerbe, and the criteria for a monomorphism with singleton image and locally Noetherian reduced source to be it
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the end of the counted proof (source lines 7156-7161) as a pointer to a result of the chapter on properties of stacks
standard_prerequisites.use: Concludes that the constructed stack is the residual gerbe.

core_obligations: Replace the stack by a groupoid: the quasi-DM hypothesis provides a flat, locally finitely presented and locally quasi-finite presentation, and the canonical map from the quotient stack of its groupoid is an equivalence, so the proof may assume the stack to be such a quotient (proof lines 7095-7108)

Restrict to the point: the proof forms the disjoint union of the spectra of the residue fields of the points of the presentation lying over the given point, a monomorphism into the presentation, and restricts the groupoid along it (proof lines 7109-7117)

Properties of the restricted groupoid: because the map of the restriction is a monomorphism followed by a locally quasi-finite morphism and the source is a disjoint union of fields, the two projections of the restricted groupoid are locally quasi-finite, flat and locally of finite presentation (proof lines 7118-7131)

The quotient is the residual gerbe: the quotient of the restricted groupoid is an algebraic stack mapping to the original one by a monomorphism, which is injective on points with image the given point and has locally Noetherian reduced source, so by uniqueness it is the residual gerbe (proof lines 7132-7161)
proof_roadmap: 由 theorem-quasi-DM 取满、平坦、局部有限表现且局部准有限的展示 U → X，则 [U/R] → X 是等价，故可设 X = [U/R]（R = U ×_X U）。

取 U' = ⊔_{u↦x} Spec κ(u)（到 U 是单射），令 R' = U' ×_X U' = R ×_{U×U}(U'×U')。由 U' 是域的谱，s', t' 既局部准有限又平坦，进而局部有限表现。于是 Z = [U'/R'] 是代数叠，Z → X 是单射（限制群胚的商映射）、点像为 {x}、且 Z 局部 Noetherian 且既约 ⇒ 由残差 gerbe 唯一性得它就是 Z_x。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that every point of a quasi-DM algebraic stack has a residual gerbe (author lemma at source lines 7087-7092, label lemma-every-point-residual-gerbe-quasi-DM). The proof (source lines 7094-7162) replaces the stack by the quotient stack of a flat, locally finitely presented and locally quasi-finite presentation, restricts that groupoid to the spectra of the residue fields of the points of the presentation lying over the given point, checks that the restricted projections are still locally quasi-finite, flat and locally of finite presentation because the source is a disjoint union of spectra of fields, and concludes that the resulting quotient stack is a monomorphism to the original with singleton image and locally Noetherian reduced source, hence the residual gerbe by uniqueness (proof lines 7095-7161). The restriction of the groupoid with its degree bookkeeping is the content. H3.
